hardwareHubs.note: Twin Cities Maker operates a workshop for woodworking, metalworking and high-precision machining.

makerspaces.name: Twin Cities Maker
makerspaces.note: Describes a workshop with tools and equipment for woodworking, metalworking and high-precision machining.

makerspaces.name: Nordeast Makers
makerspaces.note: A trade article lists a CNC router, laser cutter and etcher, CNC mill and multiple 3D printers for members.

makerspaces.name: Cannon Valley Makers
makerspaces.note: A local news article lists CNC equipment, a plasma cutter and three 3D printers.

events.name: Twin Cities Maker Fest
events.note: Free street fair of making, art and craft with a makers market and hands-on activities.

specialties.name: Medical devices
specialties.note: The state agency ranks Minnesota 2nd in electromedical apparatus manufacturing and 4th in medical equipment and supplies manufacturing.

specialties.name: Medical device industry cluster
specialties.note: A University of Minnesota study finds a concentration of medical device companies in the Twin Cities metro with many more dispersed across the state.

specialties.name: Precision machining and fabricated metal
specialties.note: The state agency names fabricated metal and machinery among the most robust clusters and ranks Minnesota 7th in precision turned products and 8th in machine shops.

support.name: Enterprise Minnesota
support.note: NIST MEP center that consults with small and medium-sized manufacturers on growth and operations.
